description: Community field-survey observations, county HER cross-references, and historic survey annotations for the UK 1 m LiDAR & Aerial Cropmark Monument Survey. Users can load/save this JSON in the web viewer or submit additions via GitHub Pull Request.

annotations.comment: Distinct Cornish annular ring-cairn / hut-circle earthwork on Bodmin Moor with well-defined circular bank and internal depression in 1 m LiDAR.
Clear concentric ring-ditch barrow relief in 1 m LiDAR accompanied by strong +4.7% ΔExG ring-ditch cropmark in aerial orthophotography.
Interesting ditch-like enclosure feature visible in 1 m bare-earth LiDAR local relief; warrants Devon HER / tithe map cross-check.
Confirmed pond / water-filled hollow in aerial imagery and 1 m LiDAR.
Confirmed farm/field pond in aerial imagery; rejected as prehistoric barrow.
